prompt: In the context of a hypothetical - Design a space mission which uses the shuttle to launch a Moon Mission module.. -  The crew and propellant stack are launched spereately...
judge_reasoning: Candidate 1 is the only response that directly designs a lunar mission architecture matching the prompt’s key requirement: using the shuttle to launch a Moon module with the crew and propellant stack launched separately and then rendezvousing. Candidates 2–4 are largely off-target, focusing on general engineering challenges, crew selection/training, or scientific objectives rather than the shuttle-based mission design and launch sequence. Candidate 1 also contains some speculative numeric details and an incomplete budget section, but its overall alignment to the requested mission structure is far stronger than the others.
